scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Haha, I have seen many people
but it seems you possess special power and abilities.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
哈哈，我见过很多人，
但似乎你拥有特殊的力量和能力。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
What brings you here? Is there anything bothering you recently?
Although you're already a Sage, that doesn't mean you can stop studying.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
是什么把你带到这里来的？最近有什么困扰你的事吗？
虽然你已经成为了贤者，但这并不意味着你可以停止学习。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hahah, so my little Novice, what brings you this way? ...I guess you're on a sightseeing trip?
You must have had a really hard time to reach this place. I must say, you seem interested in the Sage class.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
哈哈，我的小小初心者，是什么把你带到这里来的？...我想你是在观光吧？
你一定经历了很多艰辛才到达这里。不得不说，你似乎对贤者这个职业很感兴趣。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
*Chuckle* Although we've been studying this world for a long time, I know that studying in itself will fulfill all the needs of the people.
Other classes are just as important to the welfare of Rune-Midgarts...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
*轻笑* 虽然我们研究这个世界已经很久了，但我知道，学习本身就能满足人们的所有需求。
其他职业对于卢恩·米德加兹的福祉同样重要...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Welcome, young one. I can see that you're intrigued by the wonders of magic.
So what kind of business brings you to me?
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
欢迎，年轻人。我能看出你对魔法的奥秘很感兴趣。
那么，是什么事让你来找我呢？

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You don't seem to be qualified yet.
Remember, you must reach at least job level 40 to become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你似乎还不符合资格。
请记住，你必须达到职业等级40才能成为贤者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You possess remaining skill points...
Before you submit your dissertation, please take care this matter first.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你还有剩余的技能点...
在提交你的论文之前，请先处理这件事。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Ho~ So? Did you finally complete your dissertation? Well done.
Let me see.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
哦~ 那么？你终于完成论文了吗？干得好。
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hmm? What has happened to you? Where did you leave your dissertation?
Please bring it to me so that you may pass the test.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
嗯？你怎么了？你的论文在哪里？
请把它带给我，这样你才能通过考试。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
*Chuckle* Becoming a Sage isn't as simple as you may have assumed.
You cannot become a Sage because your magic skills are inadequate...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
*轻笑* 成为贤者并不像你想象的那么简单。
你不能因为魔法技能不足就成为贤者...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You'd better leave and increase your reputation.
Never forget that once you also used to be a novice.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你最好离开，去提升你的声望。
永远不要忘记，你也曾经是初心者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Our knowledge is the mainspring of activity which helps the kingdom to be developed faster.
Please keep this in mind: you must study and record everything you've discovered so that all in the kingdom may benefit.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
我们的知识是活动的动力，有助于王国更快地发展。
请记住这一点：你必须学习和记录你发现的一切，以便王国中的所有人都能受益。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
If you aspire to become a Sage, you must first live life as a Mage. Only then shall you have a chance.
I am looking forward seeing you again.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
如果你渴望成为贤者，你必须先作为魔法师生活。只有这样你才有机会。
我期待再次见到你。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
However, if you happen to meet a Sage down the road, I hope you will lend him your assistance.
And if you do, he shall repay you in kind...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
不过，如果你在路上遇到一位贤者，我希望你能给予他帮助。
如果你这样做了，他也会以同样的方式回报你...

scripts.text: I would like to be a Sage.
scripts.translation: 我想成为贤者。

scripts.text: Let me know about the Sage job change.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于贤者转职的事。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hm? Do you wish to become a Sage?
Well then, I would like to suggest a few things that are required of a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
嗯？你想成为贤者？
那么，我想提出一些成为贤者所必需的条件。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Sages are those who promote the development of this continent through the endless studying and recording of all knowledge related to this world.
Becoming a Sage is more than just a costume change: It's an important job where you must be always aware of your duty and responsibility to the people.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
贤者是通过无尽地学习和记录与这个世界相关的所有知识，来促进这片大陆发展的人。
成为贤者不仅仅是换一套衣服：这是一项重要的工作，你必须时刻意识到自己对人民的责任和义务。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
You may want to enter an enrollment application to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
I believe they can explain in detail what you need to become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
你可能需要向施韦希比尔魔法学院提交入学申请。
我相信他们可以详细解释成为贤者需要什么。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Sage job change...hmm...an interesting turn of phrase, I must say.
Although that is what we say, it is very inappropriate to think of becoming a Sage as merely changing a job.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
贤者转职...嗯...不得不说，这是一个有趣的说法。
虽然我们是这么说的，但把成为贤者仅仅看作换一份工作是非常不恰当的。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
In order to be a Sage, you must enter an application to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
You will then take the entrance examination.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
要成为贤者，你必须向施韦希比尔魔法学院提交入学申请。
之后，你将参加入学考试。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
After the examination, you will be assigned to study a specific subject...
and finally, you will submit your dissertation to the university.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
考试结束后，你将被分配学习特定的科目...
最后，你需要向学院提交你的论文。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
I am the one who evaluates your dissertation.
When you pass all the courses, you will become a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
由我来评估你的论文。
当你通过所有课程后，你将成为一名贤者。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Please visit the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
A young Sage named Metheus Sylphe will accept your application.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
请前往施韦希比尔魔法学院。
一位名叫梅修斯·西尔菲的年轻贤者将受理你的申请。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
I see...Well, seeing as you have leisure time to spare, I encourage you to peruse as many books as you can.
You can find and research every worldly matter within their pages.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
我明白了...既然你有空闲时间，我鼓励你尽可能多地阅读书籍。
你可以在书页间找到并研究世间万物。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Ah yes, you can not become the most intelligent person merely by reading all the books around you...
However, for a Sage such as myself, the knowledge found in books is most important.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
啊，是的，仅仅阅读周围所有的书并不能让你成为最聪明的人...
然而，对于像我这样的贤者来说，书中蕴含的知识是最重要的。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
嗯...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Huh...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
咦...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Interesting...
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
有意思...

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Although it's roughly written, it's well done for a beginner.
Ah yes...you seem to be proficient in studying.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
虽然写得比较粗糙，但对于初学者来说已经很不错了。
啊，是的...看来你很擅长学习。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Congratulations! You have now become a Sage.
Always remember to keep a studious and analytical mindset.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
恭喜！你现在已经成为一名贤者了。
请始终铭记保持好学和分析的心态。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Also, keep this dissertation and treat it with care, since it is one and only book you have written.
You may have need of it one of these days. And it shall forever remind of this grandiose moment.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
另外，请妥善保管这篇论文，因为这是你唯一写过的书。
也许有一天你会需要它。它将永远提醒你这一辉煌的时刻。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Well then...May God fill your path with knowledge.
Study with diligence!!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
那么...愿神赐予你知识的道路。
努力学习吧！！

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Wait...you didn't lose it, did you?
Well...that's your business. It is regrettable that you won't be able to get a chance to write a book anymore.
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
等等...你没有弄丢它吧？
好吧...那是你的事。很遗憾，你将再没有机会写书了。

scripts.text:
[Kayron Grik]
Study diligently, and return when you finish your dissertation.
Until then, farewell!
scripts.translation:
[凯隆·格里克]
努力学习，完成论文后再回来。
在那之前，再见！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the
Schweicherbil Magic
Academy. W-wait a second...
Do I know you from somewhere?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。
等...等一下...
我是不是在哪里见过你？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh nice to meet you again, long time no see.
So how's it going with the studying?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
哦，很高兴再次见到你，好久不见。
那么，学习进展如何？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
Oh, You're a Mage. How may I assist you?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎来到施韦希比尔魔法学院。
哦，你是魔法师。有什么可以帮你的吗？

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Welcome, once again.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
欢迎再次光临。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Huh? What are you doing here? You're supposed to be taking the entrance test by now.
Please visit Professor Claytos in the left room.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
咦？你在这里做什么？你应该正在参加入学考试才对。
请去左边的房间找克莱托斯教授。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh, are you done with the dissertation?
Sure, you can submit it to Dean Kayron.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
哦，论文写完了吗？
当然可以，你可以把它交给凯隆院长。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh sorry, this is a rather inconvenient time to converse.
Please come back later. I apologize for troubling you.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
抱歉，现在不太方便交谈。
请稍后再来。打扰了，非常抱歉。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
We've met before, haven't
we? Oh gosh, I must sound
pretty crazy. I'm sorry, I guess it's because I haven't been
sleeping too well? Oh well,
have a good day, adventurer~
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
我们以前见过面，对吧？
天哪，我听起来一定很疯。
抱歉，大概是因为我最近没睡好吧？
算了，祝你今天愉快，冒险者~

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
It's okay to study books and magic scrolls all day, 
but you must go outside and fight with monsters as much as you can in order to be a well experienced Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
整天研究书籍和魔法卷轴是可以的，
但为了成为一名经验丰富的贤者，你必须多去外面与魔物战斗。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you know any Sage candidates, please give them some advice...
Also, please give my regards to your colleagues as well.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
如果你认识任何贤者候选人，请给他们一些建议...
另外，请代我向你的同事们问好。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
This place is specialized in Sage class training. Mostly, what we do is study about monsters and magic spells.
We always welcome new students.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
这里专门负责贤者职业的训练。我们主要研究魔物和魔法咒语。
我们随时欢迎新学生。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
People who are at job jevel 40 as Mage class are qualified to apply for enrollment.
By passing selected courses, we will then approve them as Sages.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
魔法师职业等级达到40级的人有资格申请入学。
通过指定课程后，我们将批准他们成为贤者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you're interested in the Sage class, please come again.
And have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
如果你对贤者职业感兴趣，请再次光临。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
This place is specialized in Sage class training. What we do is study about monsters and magic spells.
People who are at job jevel 40 as Mage class are qualified to apply for enrollment.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
这里专门负责贤者职业的训练。我们主要研究魔物和魔法咒语。
魔法师职业等级达到40级的人有资格申请入学。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
If you have any Mage friends, please let them know about this academy.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
如果你有魔法师朋友，请告诉他们这所学院的事。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text: Let me know about the Sage job change.
scripts.translation: 告诉我关于贤者转职的事。

scripts.text: I want to enroll in the school.
scripts.translation: 我想报名入学。

scripts.text: Nothing.
scripts.translation: 没什么。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I see. Do you wish to become a Sage?
Unfortunately, we are not in charge of changing your job to the Sage class.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
我明白了。你想成为贤者吗？
不幸的是，我们并不负责将你的职业转换为贤者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
After you enter this academy and pass certain courses...
you will receive official approval to conduct studies as a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
进入这所学院并通过特定课程后...
你将获得官方批准，以贤者身份进行研究。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
For this reason, we do not speak of this proccess as a job change, but as graduation.
Anyway, if you enter your application for this academy, I will inform you about the registration fee and will let you take the test.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
因此，我们不称这个过程为转职，而是称为毕业。
总之，如果你提交入学申请，我会告知你注册费，并让你参加考试。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
For your information, if you bring ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000, 
you don't have to pay for the Registration Fee to enroll in the school.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
供你参考，如果你携带^3355FF旧魔法书^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000，
就不需要支付注册费即可入学。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
After you register, you will be able to take the entrance test.
If you pass the test, you will write a thesis for a given subject.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
注册后，你就可以参加入学考试了。
如果通过考试，你需要就指定主题撰写论文。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The Dean of the academy will decide whether or not you are qualified.
If you're granted admission, you will be able to join in study and research activities as a Sage.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
学院院长将决定是否批准你的资格。
如果获得录取，你将能够以贤者身份参与学习和研究活动。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
You're always welcome to join us.
Have a good day.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
我们随时欢迎你加入。
祝你今天愉快。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I see, you want to join the academy. Once again, welcome to the Schweicherbil Magic Academy.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
我明白了，你想加入学院。再次欢迎加入施韦希比尔魔法学院。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
People who have already met the basic requirement by reaching at Mage job level 40 are qualified for enrollment.
A small registration fee will also be required.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
只要达到魔法师职业等级40，即符合基本入学资格。
此外，还需要缴纳少量的注册费。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
The registration fee is 70,000 zeny.
However, if you bring ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000, you will be exempt from this fee.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
注册费为70,000 Zeny。
不过，如果您携带^3355FF旧魔法书^000000和^3355FF慧眼^000000，就可以免除这笔费用。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
So, do you wish to apply immediately?
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
那么，您希望立即申请吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I do.
scripts.translation: 有的，我有。

scripts.text: The fee is much too expensive.
scripts.translation: 费用太贵了

scripts.text: I will come back later.
scripts.translation: 我稍后再来

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
I'm sorry, but you haven't met the basic requirements yet.
Please go study more and reach Mage job level 40 first.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
很抱歉，您尚未满足基本入学要求。
请先继续学习，达到魔法师职业等级40后再来。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
You have unused skill points left. Please go learn all those skills you've been planning to learn.
We do not accept any ambiguous candidates.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
您还有未使用的技能点。请去把您计划学习的技能都学会。
我们不接受任何含糊其辞的申请者。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Very well. Let's complete your application form.
Please put your signature here.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
好的。让我们完成您的申请表。
请在这里签名。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Your name is ... {0}. It's a very nice name.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
您的名字是... {0}。是个很不错的名字。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Oh, you've mastered the Mage job! You're great!! *Clap Clap Clap*
In reward for your great effort, you will be exempt from the registration fee!
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
哦，您已经精通了魔法师职业！太棒了！！*鼓掌鼓掌鼓掌*
作为对您出色表现的奖励，您将免除注册费！

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Yes, everything's ready.
Next, you will take an entrance test.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
是的，一切准备就绪。
接下来，您将参加入学考试。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Please visit Professor Claytos.
He's in the left room.
scripts.translation:
[梅修斯·西尔菲]
请去拜访克莱托斯教授。
他在左边的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Metheus Sylphe]
Will you pay the registration fee with 70,000 zeny?
Or will you give me ^3355FFOld Magicbook^000000 and ^3355FFNecklace of Wisdom^000000?

scripts.translation:

scripts.text:
[Claytos Verdo]

scripts.translation:

所以，要坚强且独立。试着去探索那些无人涉足的地方。

scripts.text:

如果你有任何问题，去拜访我指派给你的智者吧。

[Hermes Tris]
I know how hard it is to explore all those perilous areas, but it will help you to gain more knowledge.
Book smarts never can beat street smarts.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
我知道探索那些危险区域很困难，但这能帮助你获得更多知识。
书本知识永远无法胜过实践经验。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
However, it's a very dangerous idea to go deep inside a dungeon alone. 
You'd better look for trustworthy comrades.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
不过，独自深入迷宫是非常危险的想法。
你最好寻找可靠的同志。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
In this continent of Rune-Midgarts, there are a lot of unknown places and objects that haven't been fully discovered.

[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
在卢恩·米德加兹这片大陆上，有许多尚未被完全发现的未知地点和物品。
魔物、神秘物品以及神话中的英雄...

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Why don't you consider being a Sage in the future?
You will love studying the world.
scripts.translation:

你不妨考虑一下未来成为贤者。
你会爱上研究这个世界的。

scripts.text:

If by chance you do decide to do that, we'll meet again.
Take care, kiddy.
scripts.translation:

如果你碰巧决定这么做，我们会再见的。
保重，小鬼头。

We Sages are more like scholars than Mages.
We are very helpful and powerful as members of a party.
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
我们贤者更像学者，而不是魔法师。
作为队伍成员，我们非常有用且强大。

scripts.text:
[Hermes Tris]
Try to make a party with a Sage next time.
The wisdom a Sage will bring will be more than helpful for your party...
scripts.translation:
[赫尔墨斯·特里斯]
下次试着组建一个有贤者的队伍。
贤者带来的智慧将对你的队伍大有裨益...

scripts.text:

Register your application and take the written test first.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

All you have to do is kill all the monsters within the time limit.
scripts.translation:

你只需要在限时内消灭所有魔物即可。

[Hermes Tris]

How about it? Are you ready to take this test?

与其听别人说一百遍，不如亲自体验一下。
怎么样？准备好参加这个考试了吗？

scripts.text: Yes, I am.
scripts.translation: 是的，我是。

scripts.text: Sorry, give me some time.

Do your best and come back safely!

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The root of this world, Yggdrasil, is a gigantic tree.
It takes root all over the continent of Rune-Midgarts and its leaves reach the sky.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
这个世界的根源，尤克特拉希尔，是一棵巨大的树。
它的根系遍布卢恩·米德加兹大陆，枝叶则伸向天空。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Outside of this continent, there is a ocean where a giant snake named Yormungandr is coiled up.
The world as we know it consists of 3 places: Asgard, Midgard and Utgard.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
在这片大陆之外，有一片海洋，那里盘踞着一条名为耶梦加得的巨蛇。
我们所知的世界由三个地方组成：阿斯加德、米德加尔特和乌特加德。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Utgard is where all the titans live.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
乌特加德是所有泰坦居住的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Midgard is where all human beings live.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
米德加尔特是所有人类居住的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
And Asgard is where the gods reside...
An ash tree taking root in the middle of the Rune-Midgarts continent, that is Yggdrasil.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
而阿斯加德是众神居住的地方...
一棵扎根于卢恩·米德加兹大陆中央的白杨树，那就是尤克特拉希尔。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
This continent was born from the heart of Ymir, and Yggdrasil holds the continent together by grasping it with its 3 roots.
These roots stretch into 3 different places.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
这片大陆诞生于尤弥尔的心脏，而尤克特拉希尔用它的三根根须将其紧紧抓住，维系着大陆。
这些根须延伸向三个不同的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The first root reaches Asgard where the gods live and 
where we, mere humans, haven't yet explored or experienced.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
第一根根须延伸至众神居住的阿斯加德，
那是我们凡人尚未探索或体验过的地方。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The second root reaches Jotunnheim where all the giants live.
We've been told this name many times through myths and legends.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
第二根根须延伸至所有巨人居住的约顿海姆。
我们在神话和传说中多次听到过这个名字。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The third one reaches Niflheim.
That place is rumored to be covered with a thick, black fog.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
第三根根须延伸至尼弗尔海姆。
据说那个地方被浓厚的黑色迷雾所笼罩。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Items, such as Seed of Yggdrasil, Yggdrasilbrry and Leaf of Yggdrasil are
considered a part of Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
像尤克特拉希尔之种、尤克特拉希尔浆果和尤克特拉希尔之叶这样的物品，
都被认为是尤克特拉希尔之树的一部分。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Yggdrasilberry has a fascinating scent that is rumored to
restore full HP and SP at once.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
尤克特拉希尔浆果散发着迷人的香气，
据说它能一次性恢复全部HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The seed of Yggdrasil which has the fragrance of a blooming flower and the flavor of nut is rumored to
restore half of HP and SP at once.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
尤克特拉希尔之种散发着盛开的花朵的香气，味道像坚果，
据说它能一次性恢复一半的HP和SP。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
The leaf of Yggdrasil which is filled with vital force is rumored to
revive the dead, bringing them back to this world.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
尤克特拉希尔之叶充满了生命力，
据说它能复活死者，让他们回到这个世界。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Lastly... if by some chance you discover a way into Asgard in the future, 
I hope you will find the Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
最后...如果将来你们有幸找到了通往阿斯加德的道路，
希望你们能找到尤克特拉希尔之树。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
Even though the story of the Yggdrasil tree only exists in myths and legends, 
we Sages are obligated to discover the truth of the Yggdrasil tree.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
虽然尤克特拉希尔之树的故事只存在于神话和传说中，
但我们贤者有义务去探索尤克特拉希尔之树的真相。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
That is the end of today's class.
Please record the articles you've learned today, and try to remember as much as you can.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
今天的课就到这里。
请记录下今天学到的知识，并尽量记住它们。

scripts.text:
[Saphien Layless]
In the next class, you will write a thesis about Yggdrasil...
Please bring the following items to prepare for class.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
下节课，你们要写一篇关于尤克特拉希尔的论文...
请准备以下物品以备上课使用。

scripts.text:

^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 which will be used for holding the squid ink.

[Saphien Layless]
I will help you to write your thesis when you're ready with all those items.
I am looking forward to the next class with you.
scripts.translation:
[萨菲恩·莱勒斯]
当你们准备好所有物品后，我会帮助你们撰写论文。
我很期待与你们的下一节课。

What, you already forgot what I told you just a minute before?
What a nusance... listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么，你刚才才听我说过就忘了吗？
真让人头疼...这次请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Well done. So, did you watch insects while gathering those items?
Oh well, I believe you did a good job with the task.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
做得好。那么，你在收集这些物品时观察昆虫了吗？
算了，我相信你很好地完成了任务。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, you already forgot what I told you?
What a nuisance...listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么，你忘了我刚才说的话吗？
真让人头疼...这次请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Zzz...Zzz...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
呼...呼...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Hmph. Lucky brat brought all of the items.
Well, I don't expect you to write an outrageously great thesis though...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
哼。拉基把所有物品都带来了。
不过，我不指望你能写出多么出色的论文...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What, are you sure that you're ready? No, I don't think so.
Oh well... listen carefully this time.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么，你确定你准备好了吗？不，我觉得你还没准备好。
算了...这次请仔细听好。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What are you doing here, Go show your thesis to the dean!
Don't wasn't any more time here.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你在这里做什么？去把你的论文交给院长！
这里没有多余的时间给你浪费。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Wah~! My brain is gonna blow up soon! Why must I have to prepare all of these things?!
Who are you?! Don't disturb me, I'm busy!!
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
哇~！我的脑子快要爆炸了！为什么我要准备所有这些东西？！
你是谁？！别打扰我，我很忙！！

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You don't know how busy person I am...don't you?
If you're a Sage, you're supposed to know about me by now.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你不知道我有多忙...你不知道吗？
如果你是贤者，你应该已经听说过我了。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You have too much time on your hands. Go explore some dungeons.
I think it will be more helpful than wasting your time on me.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你太闲了。去探索一些地下城吧。
我觉得这比把时间浪费在我身上更有帮助。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You'd better go out and play with your pals. 
This is not a place where you can fool around.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你最好出去和你的朋友们玩。
这里不是你可以胡闹的地方。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You're allowed to watch. However, do not disturb them by making any fuss.
And keep your hands off, some of these guys are way too dangerous to touch.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你可以观看。但是，不要大惊小怪地打扰它们。
还有，别乱碰，其中一些家伙太危险了，不能触碰。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
By the way, if you catch any rare monsters in future, let me know.
I am willing to purchase those at any cost.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
顺便说一句，如果你以后捕获到任何稀有魔物，请告诉我。
我愿意不惜一切代价购买它们。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Huh...how rude of you! You're expected to introduce yourself to me as soon as I greet you!
What is your name, young one?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
哼...你真没礼貌！我跟你打招呼时，你应该立刻向我介绍自己！
你叫什么名字，年轻人？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
A fine name. It's nice to meet you.
So, are you aware of the subject you're studying?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
好名字。很高兴认识你。
那么，你知道自己正在学习的科目吗？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
As you know, your topic of study is monsters.
How many times have you fought with monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
如你所知，你的研究主题是魔物。
你与魔物战斗过多少次？

scripts.text: Well, I can't even count.
scripts.translation: 多到数不清。

scripts.text: A few times, I guess...
scripts.translation: 大概几次吧...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Oh shut up, you brat. Don't be so sure about yourself.
Even if you have much experience with monsters, you will have a hard time comprehending my lecture.
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, that's what I guessed about you. You're just book smart.
However, I am sure you will encounter most of the monsters mentioned in my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
闭嘴，你这小鬼。别这么自以为是。
即使你对魔物很有经验，理解我的讲座也会很吃力。
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
没错，我猜你就是这样。你只是死读书。
不过，我相信你会遇到我讲座中提到的大部分魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]

However, I am sure you will encounter most of the monsters mentioned in my lecture.
scripts.translation:

没错，我猜你就是这样。你只是死读书。
不过，我相信你会遇到我讲座中提到的大部分魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Let's get started.
Make sure you're ready for the practical examination during my lecture.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
我们开始吧。
请确保你已准备好应对我讲座中的实践考试。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring the following items to me.
5 ^3355FFTentacle^000000,
5 ^3355FFSingle Cell^000000,
5 ^3355FFFish Tail^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
去给我带以下物品来。
5个 ^3355FF触手^000000，
5个 ^3355FF单细胞^000000，
5个 ^3355FF鱼尾^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring the following items to me.
5 ^3355FFNipper^000000,
5 ^3355FFClam Flesh^000000,
5 ^3355FFHeart of Mermaid^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
去给我带以下物品来。
5个 ^3355FF钳子^000000，
5个 ^3355FF蛤蜊肉^000000，
5个 ^3355FF美人鱼之心^000000。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Go bring following items to me.
5 ^3355FFTendon^000000,
5 ^3355FFNipper^000000,
5 ^3355FFSharp Scale^000000.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
去给我带以下物品来。
5个 ^3355FF肌腱^000000，
5个 ^3355FF钳子^000000，

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I will proceed with the class when you bring those to me.
Have fun.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
等你把这些带给我，我就继续上课。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Somehow the monsters that drop those items have something in common.
Can you tell me what that similarity is?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
掉落这些物品的魔物似乎有某种共同点。
你能告诉我那个相似之处是什么吗？

scripts.text: They possess water property.
scripts.translation: 它们拥有水属性。

scripts.text: They are fishes.
scripts.translation: 它们是鱼类。

scripts.text: They are aggressive.
scripts.translation: 它们具有攻击性。

scripts.text: Um...they monsters.
scripts.translation: 呃...它们是魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, they possess water property and at the same time they are fishes.
Most fish class monsters live underwater, so they are attributed with the water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
是的，它们拥有水属性，同时它们也是鱼类。
大多数鱼类魔物生活在水下，因此被赋予水属性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yes, they possess water property and at the same time they are fishes.
Most fish class monsters live underwater, so they are attributed with the water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
是的，它们拥有水属性，同时它们也是鱼类。
大多数鱼类魔物生活在水下，因此被赋予水属性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
...I didn't know Phens were aggressive nowadays?
Or do Marina and Plankton team up to start a fight with you?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
...我不知道现在的剑鱼这么有攻击性？
还是说玛丽娜和漂浮虫联手跟你打架？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
All the monsters from which you obtained these items are not agressive... get a grip.
They are all fishes and possess water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你获得这些物品的魔物都不具有攻击性...清醒一点。
它们都是鱼类，并且拥有水属性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What...! What are you here for!? You are here to study about specific monsters, microcephalic moron!
Sigh...they are all fishes and possess water property.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么...！你来这里做什么！？你是来研究特定魔物的，小头蠢货！
唉...它们都是鱼类，并且拥有水属性。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Not all fish class monsters possess water property, but most of them do.
So which kind of magic would work best on most fish class monsters?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
并非所有鱼类魔物都拥有水属性，但大多数都有。
那么，哪种魔法对大多数鱼类魔物最有效？

scripts.text: Lightening Bolt.
scripts.translation: 闪电术

scripts.text: Fire Bolt.
scripts.translation: 火箭术

scripts.text: Thunder Storm.
scripts.translation: 雷暴术

scripts.text: Frost Diver.
scripts.translation: 冰锥术

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
That's right, Lightening Bolt, which possesses the wind property, works best on water property monsters.
Although you might want to be careful of monsters that recognize magic casting.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
没错，闪电术拥有风属性，对水属性魔物效果最佳。
不过，你可能需要小心那些能识别魔法施放的魔物。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
What? Fire Bolt! Fire cannot beat water, you imbecile!
Most fishes are attributed with the water property. Therefore, they are weak to wind property magic spells. Don't you get it?
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
什么？火箭术！火克不了水，你这个蠢货！
大多数鱼类都被赋予水属性。因此，它们对风属性魔法法术比较脆弱。你不懂吗？

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Yeah, Thunder Storm spell is fine... it's a wind property spell.
However, you will be in trouble if you use the spell in a poorly chosen spot.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
嗯，雷暴术也不错...它是风属性法术。
但是，如果你在不合适的地点使用这个法术，就会陷入麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
I can't fathom such stupidity! This question asks you to choose a property that counters water! Don't you get it?
Logically, any magic spell possessing the water property cannot overcome the water atrribute monsters!
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
我无法理解这种愚蠢！这个问题让你选择克制水属性的属性！你不懂吗？
从逻辑上讲，任何拥有水属性的魔法法术都无法克制水属性魔物！

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
By the way, although some monsters such as Penomena or Aster are considered to be fish class monsters, 
they have a different property than the others. You'd better be careful with them.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
顺便说一下，虽然梅纳海葵或海星等魔物被视为鱼类魔物，
但它们的属性与其他鱼类不同。你最好小心对待它们。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Okay, let me teach you about insect monsters.
Let's see... hmm... hmm...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
好吧，让我教你关于昆虫魔物的知识。
让我看看...嗯...嗯...

祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Insect class monsters do not share the same property most of the time, 
You must think twice before you cast a magic spell on an insect.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
昆虫魔物通常不共享相同的属性，
在对昆虫施放魔法之前，你必须三思。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
It's remarkable that insects can detect hidden objects.
Therefore, any hiding skill such as the Hiding skill or Cloaking skill will not work on insect monsters.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
昆虫能探测隐藏物体，这一点很了不起。
因此，像隐匿或伪装这样的隐藏技能对昆虫魔物无效。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
Some insects form a group and live together.
They are controlled by the head of the group...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
有些昆虫成群结队地生活在一起。
它们由群体的首领控制...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
For instance, Maya the queen ant...
Mistress, the queen of hornets,
or Golden Thiefbug, the king of thiefbugs...
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
例如，蚁后玛雅...
蜂后，蜂兵的女王，
或者金盗虫，盗虫之王...

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You cannot beat those boss monsters alone, 
you'd better form a party if you want to fight with them.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你无法独自击败那些首领魔物，
如果你想与它们战斗，最好组建一个队伍。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
That's the end of my class...it's time for you to write a thesis.
Bring me following items for writing the thesis.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
我的课就到这里了...该写论文了。
请带着以下物品来写论文。

[Lucius Celsus]

I will help you in writing the thesis when you bring all of those items.
You're almost there. Isn't learning easy?
scripts.translation:

当你带齐所有物品时，我会帮你写论文。
你快完成了。学习是不是很容易？

scripts.text:

Well, if you really want to write it by yourself, I can let you handle it but...
I will give you a work of staggering genius. Just make a copy of it under your name.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
好吧，如果你真的想自己写，我可以让你处理，但是...
我会给你一篇惊世骇俗的杰作。只要把它抄下来，署上你的名字就行。

scripts.text:
[Lucius Celsus]
You got a problem with that? Tough, that's my style.
Just do what I say.
scripts.translation:
[卢修斯·塞尔苏斯]
你有意见吗？那就忍着，这是我的风格。
照我说的做。

哎呀，你真是最可爱的初心者~

[Aebecee George]
Hey there, tee hee, how's it going sailor?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
嘿，嘻嘻，水手，最近怎么样？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hello~? Nice to meet you, tee hee.
Did you come to see me? Oh, you're a student!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你好~？很高兴见到你，嘻嘻。
你是来看我的吗？哦，你是学生啊！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh~ how sweet! You brought them all~ thank you~
Oh, can you wait a little bit? I need to do something before we start. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哦~真甜！你都带来了~谢谢你~
哦，你能等一下吗？开始之前我需要做点事情。嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
You don't have all the items? And here I was, getting all hot and bothered.
Go on, sweetheart, and hurry baaack~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你没有带齐所有物品？我还以为会很刺激呢。
去吧，亲爱的，快点回来~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh~ how sweet! You brought them all~ Oh thank you~
Well now, let's get down to business. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哦~真甜！你都带来了~哦，谢谢你~
好了，让我们开始正事吧。嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, precious...are you trying to fool me? Tee hee~
I hope you didn't sell the elemental ores I gave you? Naughty naughty~ Don't you know diamonds are a girl's best friend? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你在这里做什么，亲爱的...是在骗我吗？嘻嘻~
希望你没有把我给你的元素矿石卖掉？坏孩子~你不知道钻石是女孩最好的朋友吗？嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh~ how sweet! You brought some Holy Water~ thanks honey~
Oh righty, we should start class. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哦~真甜！你带了一些圣水~谢谢亲爱的~
对了，我们应该开始上课了。嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, precious...are you playing games? Tee hee.
Oh, poor dear. Did you already forget what I told you? Do you want me to remind you? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你在这里做什么，亲爱的...是在玩弄我吗？嘻嘻。
哦，可怜的孩子。你已经忘记我告诉你的话了吗？需要我提醒你吗？嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
So...do you have the time? I'm kidding, girlfriend!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
那么...你有时间吗？我在开玩笑呢，亲爱的！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay~ so its now or never~ tee hee~
I taught you everything I know. Don't be nervous, you'll be okay~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
好了~就是现在~嘻嘻~
我把我知道的都教给你了。别紧张，你会没事的~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you still doing here, sweet cheeks? Tee hee~
Oh, poor dear. Did you already forget what I told you? Do you want me to remind you? Not a problem, tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你还在这里做什么，甜心？嘻嘻~
哦，可怜的孩子。你已经忘记我告诉你的话了吗？需要我提醒你吗？没问题，嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, dearie? Don't you want to meet the dean and show him your stuff?
Take it from me, boys like him won't wait for you forever, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你在这里做什么，亲爱的？你不想去见院长并展示你的成果吗？
听我的，像他那样的男孩不会永远等你，嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well well...what do we have here?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哎呀...这是什么情况？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh well, although you have become a Sage, you're just doing the same thing, tee hee...we're mages down to the core!
We're way better than any other class because we're pretty good with our heads, you know?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
虽然你已经成为了贤者，但你做的还是同样的事情，嘻嘻...我们骨子里都是魔法师！
我们比其他任何职业都强，因为我们头脑很好，你知道吗？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay, is there anything you want to talk about?
Oh dearie, don't be nervous...where's your sense of adventure?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
好了，有什么想聊的吗？
哦亲爱的，别紧张...你的冒险精神去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
What are you doing here, sweetcakes? Do you just come over to see what's in here?
Do you want some candy? Candy, my precious? Tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你在这里做什么，甜心？你只是来看看里面有什么吗？
你想要一些糖果吗？糖果，我的宝贝？嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh gosh...Sorry, I thought I had some...
But I've got other treats, you catch my drift?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
天哪...抱歉，我以为我有一些...
但我有其他的小点心，你懂我的意思吗？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Did you come here to look around? Huh...?
Well, if you're not here for business, you must be here...
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
你来这里四处看看的吗？嗯...？
如果你不是来办正事的，那你一定是来...

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
...for PLEASURE.
Hey wait! Come back~!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
...寻求快乐的。
嘿，等等！回来~！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, I am the Professor in charge of you, Abecee George.
So...aren't you happy to be with me, dearie? Aren't you gay? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
嘻嘻，我是负责你的教授，艾贝西·乔治。
那么...和我在一起你不开心吗，亲爱的？你不高兴吗？嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
However, before we get start class, I need you to do me...a favor.
Don't be scared, its just an eensy weensy favor. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
不过，在我们开始上课之前，我需要你帮我...一个小忙。
别害怕，只是一个微不足道的小忙。嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Please bring me ^3355FF30 Stone^000000, that's all.
It's not so hard, isn't it?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
请给我带^3355FF30块石头^000000，仅此而已。
这不难，对吧？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Why don't you ask a thief pal for help?
We'll start the class when you bring me those stones~ Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
为什么不找个盗贼朋友帮忙呢？
等你把石头带给我，我们就开始上课~ 嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hocus-focus!!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
呼~呼~呼~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Hocus~focus!!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
呼~呼~呼~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Ho~cus~fo~cus!!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
呼~呼~呼~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Tee hee, you naughty stone~
Only 3 of them worked for me. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
嘻嘻，你这只调皮的石头~
只有3块对我有用。嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Here's my other favor to ask of you. Oh, are those tears of...joy?
Oh, I'm sooo excited too! Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
这是我请求你做的另一件事。哦，那是...喜悦的泪水吗？
哦，我也太兴奋了！嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I will give you these elemental ores...but...they are not for free.
Whoa there cowboy! Don't pull out so soon~ Listen, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
我会给你这些元素矿石...但是...不是免费的。
嘿，牛仔先生！别急着掏枪~ 听我说，嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Please make arrows using these items and bring them to me, pretty please~
50 ^3355FFCrystal Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFStone Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFWind Arrow^000000.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
请用这些材料制作箭矢并带给我，拜托了~
50支^3355FF水灵箭矢^000000，
50支^3355FF地灵箭矢^000000，
50支^3355FF风灵箭矢^000000。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Ask any of your Archer friends if you know any.
I am looking forward to seeing you again, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
如果你认识弓箭手朋友，可以问问他们。
我很期待再次见到你，嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I asked you to bring ^3355FF30 Stone^000000.
There are many out there, so you won't have too hard a time getting them~ tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
我让你带^3355FF30块石头^000000。
外面有很多，所以你应该不难找到~ 嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
I'll say something, and you just write everything down.
Don't forget to underline the important sentences~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
我会说一些话，你只需要把它们都记下来。
别忘了给重要的句子加下划线~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Water property magic is sooo strong against the fire property.
Just remember those burly, sexay fire fighters, shall we say, putting out that fire with water. Ooh, wet!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
水属性魔法对火属性非常强。
只要记住那些魁梧、性感的消防员，用冷水扑灭大火。哦，湿漉漉的！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Wind property magic totally dominates the water property! Oh, yes~
Think of a hot flash, and by that I mean ligntening, striking a lake. Oh, I'm bad!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
风属性魔法完全克制水属性！哦，是的~
想想闪电击中湖泊的景象。哦，我真坏！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
In terms of strength, magic with earth property goes on top of wind property magic! Ho~~
Just think of how the wind passionately beats against the cliffside near the Lookout Point or Lover's Lane. Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
就强度而言，土属性魔法胜过风属性魔法！呼~~
想想风在瞭望点或情人小径附近的悬崖边猛烈吹拂的样子。嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with fire property is strong against earth property! Tee hee~
Just think of burning wood, sprung from the earth, in a cozy fireplace. On the bearskin, in the dark~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
火属性魔法对土属性很强！嘻嘻~
想想从大地中取出的木材，在舒适的壁炉里燃烧。在熊皮上，在黑暗中~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
...Oh my gosh! Time flies sooo fast!
Let's call it a day, dear, tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
...天哪！时间过得真快！
今天就到这里吧，亲爱的，嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
When you come to the next class, bring ^3355FF1 Holy Water^000000~
I hope you have at least one Priest friend. Oh, you don't? Well, it couldn't hurt to get friendly with one.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
下次上课请带^3355FF1瓶圣水^000000~
我希望你至少有一个牧师朋友。哦，你没有吗？那交个朋友也无妨。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
50 ^3355FFCrystal Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFStone Arrow^000000,
50 ^3355FFWind Arrow^000000.
Ask your Archer friend if you have one~ tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
50支^3355FF水灵箭矢^000000，
50支^3355FF地灵箭矢^000000，
50支^3355FF风灵箭矢^000000。
如果你认识弓箭手朋友，可以问问他们~ 嘻嘻。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Just Like last time, I will speak and you just write down everything I say.
Even if you don't understand, just pretend and go with the flow, alright? Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
就像上次一样，我会说，你只需要记下我说的每一句话。
即使你不理解，也请假装理解并配合我，好吗？嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Water Magic is weak against wind property! Yes, that's right~
Just remember why you don't keep the electric fan around when you're taking a hot bubble bath. Ooh! So electric!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
水属性魔法对风属性很弱！没错~
想想为什么泡热水澡时，你不会把电风扇放在旁边。噢！真带电啊！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with the wind property is weak against earth property!
Think of how the wind can't, shall we say, penetrate a mud facial mask~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
风属性魔法对土属性很弱！
想想风是怎么吹不穿泥膜面膜的~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with earth property is weak against fire property! Tee hee~
Just think of burning wood, sprung from the earth, in a cozy fireplace. On the be--oh? I said that already? Oh poopy.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
土属性魔法对火属性很弱！嘻嘻~
想想从大地中取出的木材，在舒适的壁炉里燃烧。在熊皮上，在黑暗中~哦？我刚才说过了？哎呀。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Magic with fire property is weak against water property! Yes~
When things get flaming hot, it's best to splash things in cold water. Don't you agree~?
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
火属性魔法对水属性很弱！是的~
当东西烧得很热时，最好泼点冷水。你同意吗~？

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Oh, it's the end of the class~ tee hee.
So? Do you think you've learned a lot? You can thank me, honey!
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
哦，下课了~嘻嘻。
那么？你觉得你学到了很多吗？谢谢我，亲爱的！

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Well, that's it. You can write your thesis with what I've taught you!
Tee hee~ yes! Yes! I am the best teacher in the world! Oh, I am on fire! Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
好了，就这样。你可以用我教你的知识写论文了！
嘻嘻~是的！是的！我是世界上最好的老师！噢，我着火了！嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
Okay, please gather these items so you can write the thesis, dear~ Tee hee~
^3355FF1 Feather of Birds^000000 which will be used as a pen,
^3355FF1 Animal Skin^000000 which will be used as paper,
^3355FF1 Trunk^000000 which will be used to bind a book,
^3355FF1 Squid Ink^000000 which will be used as ink,
^3355FF1 Empty Bottle^000000 to keep that Squid Ink from splashing.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
好的，请收集这些物品，这样你就可以写论文了，亲爱的~嘻嘻~
^3355FF1鸟羽^000000，用作笔，
^3355FF1动物外皮^000000，用作纸张，
^3355FF1树干^000000，用于装订书籍，
^3355FF1墨汁^000000，用作墨水，
^3355FF1空瓶^000000，防止墨汁溅出。

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
So get on out there cowboy and hurry back~ Tee hee~
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
所以快去吧，牛仔，快点回来~嘻嘻~

scripts.text:
[Aebecee George]
^3355FF1 Holy Water^000000,
It couldn't hurt to get friendly with an Aco or Priest...tee hee.
scripts.translation:
[艾贝西·乔治]
^3355FF1圣水^000000，
和亚科或牧师交好也无妨...嘻嘻。
